types.description: Provisional generic power cable with three phase conductors L1/L2/L3 and PE. Reviewed four-core inventory; every used core requires two explicit ends and unused cores need project spare review. Unmodeled: neutral, shield/drain, connectors and bonding beyond explicit PE terminations. Size, color, materials, voltage rating and suitability are unspecified; the author must select cable and add them. Core IDs are logical phase/PE conventions, not a manufacturer pinout. Cable schema has no symbol, connectionCoverage or required fields.
